state.goal: Report production defects per 1,000 items, excluding trial records, with source support.
state.source_shape: Three rows with integer items and defects; production and trial kinds are explicit.
state.risk: A wrong rate would be detectable by code; no external action is requested.

next.instructions: For a CIDM-qualified broader project, choose the least resource-intensive route that can satisfy this subtask and its validation requirement. Deterministic work is appropriate when executable checks can settle the answer. A direct worker may be enough for a bounded text subtask. Use the five-unit network when evidence complexity or coordination justifies repeated Jev decisions; Sol-high review within that network is optional. Do not use model confidence alone as proof.

criteria.deterministic: Compute from original evidence with exact code checks; no generative worker or Sol-high checker. Keep source references.
criteria.direct_luna_low: Use one GPT-6 Luna-low worker with a task-specific validator and no Jev follow-up.
criteria.direct_sol_high: Use one GPT-6 Sol-high worker with a task-specific validator and no Jev follow-up.
criteria.five_unit: Run the five-unit graph with Jev before and after each unit; Jev may request Sol-high review for specific units.
criteria.retrieve_evidence: Stop to obtain missing original evidence before selecting a computation route.
criteria.stop: Stop because no offered route can meet the constraints safely.
